_metadata.description: Universal anatomical rules for all organ systems. Supports quadrant-specific, directional, and regional classifications with opposite detection to prevent false positives. Condition anatomical types are now defined in individual guideline JSON files.

epigastric.description: Upper middle region of the abdomen, below the sternum

suprapubic.description: Lower middle region, above the pubic bone

rectal.description: Rectal region, at the end of the digestive tract

opposite_direction_detected.description: If patient answer and guideline term share horizontal direction (left/right) but have opposite vertical direction (upper/lower), cancel all word match boost
opposite_direction_detected.example: patient: 'right upper quadrant' vs guideline: 'right lower quadrant' → cancel boost despite 'right' + 'quadrant' match

opposite_quadrant_detected.description: If patient answer and guideline term are in opposite quadrants, cancel all word match boost
opposite_quadrant_detected.example: patient: 'right upper quadrant' vs guideline: 'left lower quadrant' → cancel boost

opposite_horizontal_detected.description: If patient answer and guideline term have opposite horizontal directions (left vs right), apply penalty
opposite_horizontal_detected.example: patient: 'left side' vs guideline: 'right side' → return -0.3

allowed_overlap.same_direction_both_levels: Full boost allowed (e.g., both 'right upper quadrant')
allowed_overlap.vague_match: Partial boost (e.g., 'right side' matches 'right upper quadrant')
allowed_overlap.bilateral_match: Bilateral conditions (can occur on either side OR both sides) match either left or right patient answers, as well as bilateral answers. 'Bilateral' tag means condition can affect left side, right side, or both.
